name: calabim_horseman
description: a Calabim Horseman, a pale vampire cavalryman with red eyes and black hair under a steel kettle helmet, black armour with steel shoulder plates and a red-lined black cape, a round red shield with a black bat emblem on his RIGHT arm on the screen-left side and a steel-tipped wooden spear in his LEFT hand on the screen-right side, riding a black horse with a red bridle and red tack, a black mane and tail and dark hooves
hands: the spear stays in the rider's left hand on the screen-right side and the round red bat shield on his right arm on the screen-left side

strike.4: contact: the vampire rider leans far forward over the black horse's neck with his left arm fully extended, the spear thrust out along a line to the lower-right, its point the farthest point of the figure, the round red bat shield still on his right arm; the black horse lunges far forward toward the lower-right, low, its neck stretched out, hind legs driving; both face the lower-right
